name: Noru Signal Windbreaker
description:
A slim-cut windbreaker in black with thin horizontal stripes in electric blue — a subtle design that reads as athletic from a distance and slightly editorial up close. The shell is a lightweight ripstop nylon with a DWR finish. Chest pocket doubles as a stuff sack. Noru is a Tier 3 brand that sits between sport and street, popular in the mid-city neighborhoods where people actually run and also actually go out afterward. The fit is tailored enough to look intentional but relaxed enough to move in.

This jacket has an integrated thin-film solar weave on the shoulders and upper back — invisible in the fabric pattern — that trickle-charges whatever device is in the chest pocket. Not fast. Not impressive. But your phone will be at 40% instead of 12% when you get where you're going.
functionality: Integrated solar weave on shoulder and upper-back panels provides passive trickle charge to devices stored in chest pocket. Output is minimal — approximately 2W peak — sufficient for maintaining device charge during daily activity.
what_it_says: You're active, you're aware of your environment, and you invest in small conveniences that add up over a day.
story_hooks: Noru's solar weave is compatible with a specific aftermarket mod that converts it from trickle-charger to passive signal scanner — a conversion manual is circulating underground
Three Noru windbreakers were found at a safe house; the solar weave had been deliberately shorted in a pattern that looks like it might encode something
A Tier 3 runner who wore this jacket every morning vanished from her usual route — her jacket was found on a bench, charge indicator still blinking

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modern athletic jacket with deliberate minimalist styling. The slim-cut silhouette reads as contemporary sportswear with subtle fashion-forward details. Thin horizontal electric blue stripes create visual rhythm against matte black, catching light differently at various angles. On-body, it creates a streamlined vertical impression without bulk.
physical_description.fit: Slim but not restrictive. Tailored through the shoulders and chest, with enough room at the torso and sleeves for unrestricted movement. Cut for someone who moves—runners, couriers, people who transition between exertion and social spaces.
physical_description.primary_material: Lightweight ripstop nylon with durable water repellent (DWR) finish. Shell has an imperceptible thin-film solar weave integrated into shoulder and upper-back panels.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly crisp ripstop weave with a subtle grid pattern visible under close inspection. DWR coating gives it a light sheen without shine. Non-reflective unless wet. Solar panels are completely tactile-transparent—indistinguishable by touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black base with thin horizontal stripes in electric blue (approximately 3mm width, evenly spaced). Stripes run the full length of the front, back, and sleeves. Minimal contrast creates a 'barely there' aesthetic from distance.
physical_description.closures: Full-length center zip in gunmetal gray with rubberized grip. Small zippered chest pocket doubles as a stuff sack—self-sealing with internal friction fit.
distinctive_features: Integrated thin-film solar weave on shoulders and upper back—no visible seams or texture changes
Chest pocket designed to double as a compression stuff sack; entire jacket packs into it when inverted
Minimal branding: small woven 'Noru' label on left chest, metallic
Seams are flat-stitched and taped for weather resistance
Subtle tonal Noru logo jacquard on upper back yoke
Reflective piping only visible on inner collar—safety without aesthetic compromise
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional luxury. Affordable performance engineering with design intention. Accessible to working professionals, couriers, athletes, and mid-city residents who value both utility and visual cohesion.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street-athletic hybrid. Worn by people who move through the city intentionally—messengers, personal trainers, shift workers with style, corpo junior staff on their off hours. Signals: competent, mobile, design-conscious but not status-driven. Solar weave positions wearer as tech-aware without being corpo-ostentatious.
physical_description.condition_typical: Breaks in beautifully. New examples show crisp stripes and uniform sheen. Well-worn pieces develop creasing at elbows and shoulders, slight pilling at stress points. DWR finish degrades gracefully—water still beads but less dramatically after 2-3 years. Scuffs from bag straps and urban contact are expected wear.
